grh_f72f48e8c3570359b4cb.title: Sweethearts Protective Insurance
paragraphs: Violet Lindsley is hurt when she learns that her California-based fiancé Harry Davis has bought a novelty policy promising him cash and a Hollywood date if she jilts him. Dr. Christian jokes that hometown sweethearts ought to organize protection of their own, but Judy turns the joke into a real Hometown Sweethearts Protective Insurance Company and it quickly attracts members and national attention. Hollywood publicity man Pete Wade arrives with an offer to send the first genuinely jilted member to Hollywood for a screen test. Harry interprets Violet's participation as proof that she distrusts him and breaks their engagement, technically making her the first eligible claimant. Violet refuses the glamorous trip because she wants Harry rather than publicity. Pete stays to persuade her, becomes increasingly charmed by Violet and small-town life, loses his studio job and converts the publicity idea into a permanent national organization based in Rivers End. By the end his assignment has become personal: he introduces Violet as the future Mrs. Pete Wade, and the two leave to obtain their marriage license with Dr. Christian chosen as best man.

This [[show|dr-christian|Dr. Christian]] broadcast aired on September 16, 1942. It is listed as episode 199 in the archive. [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]] carried the broadcast. The cast includes Jean Hersholt, [[person|lurene-tuttle|Lurene Tuttle]], Mary Jane Croft, Frank Martin, and George Neise. Other credited names include Helen Scott as writer and Art Gilmore as announcer.
The surviving recording runs about 24 minutes. The broadcast is also associated with [[org|org.b199d95f77b6c241|Vaseline]].

grh_f72302abb6ec2f9307be.title: The Capture of Stacy Gault
paragraphs: El Point panics when outlaw Stacy Gault is reported nearby, and a newly arrived stranger seems to fit every detail: he resembles the wanted poster, carries yellow gloves, and has a satchel full of money wrapped in bands from the robbed White River bank. Britt prevents the frightened townsmen from simply shooting him and insists that the man be taken alive. The supposed outlaw is actually traveling salesman Amos Foster, who accidentally captured Gault when the criminal mistook one of Amos's realistic toy six-shooters for a real gun. A letter from the marshal and the reward money in Amos's satchel finally prove the truth, leaving the would-be posse badly embarrassed.

grh_f77d8321a29a0a849df4.title: The Ghost Breakers
paragraphs: Radio personality Larry Lawrence becomes entangled with Mary Carter and follows her to a supposedly haunted castle on a Cuban island she has inherited. Ghostly warnings, a zombie, secret passages and murder threats seem to confirm the island's curse, but Larry keeps discovering very human motives behind the scares. The real prize is a rich silver deposit, and Montgomery and his partners have been using the supernatural legend to frighten Mary away and keep control of it. Their conspiracy collapses in a gunfight with police, leaving Mary wealthy and Larry insisting that the ghosts were tricks, just before one final unexplained scare undercuts his certainty.

grh_f759e76fe69876015c90.title: Roberta
paragraphs: John Kent comes to Paris after his aunt, Madame Roberta, draws him into her famous fashion house.
